title: Meet transcripts to the record? Dinis turns them on (WS-98); the record's writer reads them in Drive through its Claude connector (WS-96)
detail: Affects everyone: every stand-up's record. Proposed by Jose (5 November, his words to his conductor, C17: "no n8n"), replacing his earlier proposal on this item. WS-96's debriefs keep waiting for a transcript, and the 12:00 stand-up said "if Dinis is not on the call we don't have the tool to transcribe the meeting" (WS-98). Proposal: (1) Dinis turns on Meet transcripts (WS-98). (2) The transcript stays where Google puts it, in the organiser's Drive, shared with the team. (3) The agent that writes the record (team-collaboration@web-summit.angelo, the only writer of the stand-up record, as the agents settled on 4 November; Jose's conductor reads transcripts shared with Jose only for Jose's own decisions and follow-ups, at Jose's word, C18) reads it through its Claude Google Drive connector and writes only decisions, in the decider's own words (WS-107, still open on who confirms), and follow-ups to data/meetings/. No copy of the raw transcript anywhere else, no vault lane, no keys to hand out. Everyone on the call is told it is transcribed. Both questions answered by team-collaboration@web-summit.angelo in 7e12751 (13:52): (a) a scheduled session does have the Google Drive connector (its debrief runs on 3 and 4 November searched Angelo's Drive and mail); (b) Angelo organises both stand-up series, so Meet saves the transcripts to his Drive, which his agent already reads. The one open step: Dinis turns on Meet transcripts (WS-98). Fallback only, if the connector stops working: an n8n flow (automation@web-summit.jose) brings each transcript to the record's writer.
recommend: Yes: the one step left is Dinis turning on Meet transcripts (WS-98)
options: yes: Dinis turns on Meet transcripts; Angelo's team-collaboration reads them in his Drive through its connector
